answer: Sybil resistance emerges by binding each agent identity to a write-ahead log whose append entries are gossiped as zephyr across the ocean of peers, so every whisper of a new identity must carry verifiable epoch-stamped proof. Colluding identities that reuse cache lineage violate consistency invariants, and honest nodes detect duplicate log anchors through. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
